Name: Nyapu Portrait for Slightly Cuter Aymeric
Author: SrenOrSomethin
Description:
[center]I came back from the dead just to drop this mod(?) here since I started to play Stardew Valley again lol. [/center]

[size=3][b]HOW TO USE: [/b][/size]
1) Download this mod.

2) Open your mod folder & unzip this mod in it.

3) That's it, you're done! :)

[b][size=3]ADDITIONAL NOTES:[/size][/b]
* [b]PLEASE DO NOT USE THIS FOR AI "ART" BULLSHIT[/b], I'm heavily against that shit & it's quite insulting for those who worked hard on making the portraits.

[b][size=3]CREDITS:[/size][/b]

[size=3][b]SPECIAL THANKS:[/b][/size]
A big thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/DolphinIsNotaFish?gameId=1303]DolphinIsNotAFish[/url] for converting the portraits for the content patcher; they made this mod so much more convenient to use. Please check out their other mods, I'm currently using their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20414]They Deserve It Too - Portraits for Vendors[/url] mod, which also has Nyapu's portraits! <3
